lines: Hi {first}! Karen from Talent Acquisition 👋 Quick update on our partners at the temp agency.
Temps now cost 💵 {tempcost} a fight, and legally we can no longer describe them as 'as good as you'. They aren't. They never were.
To soften the blow, here's a 💵 500 restructuring bonus. Spend it on people who grow. 🚀
heard you've lost three in a row 👀 the DAO has a channel just for your fights now.
three losses in a row?? the DAO voted to send you thoughts and prayers. it passed 4 to 3.
have you tried hiring someone who levels up? or Relaxed difficulty in Career settings? or a DAO? 🚀
